svg.title: The Station's coloured keys: Home, Vivarium, Research and Library on the four workspace positions, each cap its icon master with no word, beside Home. The device front at 4 px/mm; the screen is wireframe 15a at 0.6×.
svg.text: The coloured keys: four keys, one per section family on the screen map
The Station front at 4 px/mm (215×190 mm body, paper positions from the device-family concepts); the screen shows Home (15a) at 0.6×. Icons, never words: the front's only text is the branding on top.
a crate waits in the bay
branding, top bezel: the front's only text
title mark: the Home icon, 24×24 at (16, 8)
y 166 mm, 24 mm pitch, 18 mm caps reserved; drawn: 15 mm caps
Home drawn at 0.6× (0.1506 mm a pixel).
What each key opens, and where the ring lands
Opens Home, the ring on the room (what needs you).
On Home: the ring back to the room.
Its icon marks the titles Home and Cargo.
Opens the Vivarium's whole (15b), the ring on the mibi
last seen up close: its resident, or its bay tile while it is
out with the Companion. None seen yet: the first resident
from the left; none at home: the first bay.
From one mibi up close: the whole, the ring on that mibi.
Its icon marks the Vivarium, one mibi, Cross, Sitting.
Opens Pods, the collection, the ring on the pod that most
needs the player: a new one, then a glinting one, then the first.
From a pod, a chapter, Compare or Create: the collection.
Its icon marks Pods, Create, the Incubator, the Probe.
Opens the Library's spread, the ring on the frame it was
last on. From the Book: the spread, the ring on that species.
Its icon marks the Library and the Book.
never spends; it drops Create's and Cross's unpaid choices
and closes the namer, writing nothing; while a moment holds
input (the arrival, the hatch), it waits.
Cargo, the Incubator, the Probe: one press from Home's
column. Cargo calls from the room (the amber module and the
notice); the Incubator is reached by its jumps too.
reads like Home: the Vivarium at the left as the panel is,
the column's sections to the right, the Library at its foot.
four keys on the four positions, x 64, 88, 112, 136 mm.
Each cap carries one icon in a 10×10 mm slot, no word;
the title mark is the same icon at 24×24. A fifth key does
not fit: 15 mm free left of x 64, 16 mm right of x 136.
